Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

MAQABIS-OF-MOAB AS RIGHTEOUS GENTILE CONVERT — Per CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX-broadened parallels: Ruth Rabbah 2:9 (treating Ruth's conversion as paradigm for righteous Gentile) + Targum Pseudo-Jonathan on Ruth 1:16 (with explicit conversion-formula expansion). Maqabis's reform of his household — removing idols, sorcerers, and diviners (3:16) + learning Torah from the Jewish captive children he had brought from Jerusalem (3:17-19) — is the most explicit Gentile-king-converts-to-Mosaic-religion narrative in the Ethiopian biblical corpus. The chapter develops Maqabis as JUDGE-PATTERN exemplar — paralleling Joshua + Gideon + Samson + Barak + Deborah + Judith (vv. 1-3 catalog) — extending the deliverer-judge typology to the converted-Gentile-king. The theological climax of 2 Meqabyan: a Gentile king becomes a righteous-king-of-Israelite-pattern.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

**JUDGE-PATTERN ROSTER** — JOSHUA + GIDEON + SAMSON + BARAK + DEBORAH + JUDITH catalog (vv. 1-3). The post-conversion 2 Mq Ch 4 develops MAQABIS-OF-MOAB AS DELIVERER-JUDGE-EXEMPLAR — but the catalog is itself DISTINCTIVELY MIXED. Joshua + Gideon + Samson + Barak + Deborah are STANDARD HEBREW-BIBLE JUDGES (Joshua book + Judges 4-16). JUDITH is a DEUTEROCANONICAL-EOTC FIGURE (Book of Judith, in the Septuagint + EOTC broader canon, deliverer of Bethulia from Holofernes by beheading — Judith 13:6-8). The INCLUSION OF JUDITH alongside the canonical-Judges is STRUCTURALLY SIGNIFICANT: it marks Meqabyan as a TEWAHEDO-BROADER-CANON-AWARE text that treats the deuterocanonical-women alongside Hebrew-Bible figures as functionally-equivalent deliverer-exemplars. The roster extends the deliverer-judge typology to the converted-Gentile-king — supporting the seed 4:15 reading of Maqabis-of-Moab as RIGHTEOUS GENTILE CONVERT integrated into the Israelite deliverer-tradition.

The chapter develops the converted-king as DOMESTIC reformer before re-emerging as deliverer-judge in Ch 6.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

IDOLS-AND-SORCERERS PURGE of Maqabis-of-Moab's household (vv. 5-9; expands seed 3:16 + 3:17-19): removal of household-idols + expulsion of sorcerers + diviners + Torah-instruction from the captive Jewish children. The household-religious-reform pattern parallels: 2 KINGS 23:1-25 (Josiah's reform — destroying high-places + groves + altars + pulling-down houses-of-male-prostitutes); 2 CHRONICLES 14:3-5 (Asa's reform); 2 CHRONICLES 17:3-6 (Jehoshaphat's reform); 2 KINGS 18:4 (Hezekiah breaking the bronze serpent + cutting-down groves); MATTHEW 12:43-45 par. (the cleansed-and-empty-house parable). Meqabyan's distinctive contribution: the reform is GENTILE-LED (Maqabis-of-Moab is a Moabite-king who initiates Mosaic-religious-reform within his own pagan-household) — the most-explicit-Gentile-king-as-religious-reformer narrative in the EOTC canon. The chapter develops the converted-king as DOMESTIC reformer before re-emerging as deliverer-judge in Ch 6.

MAQABIS-OF-MOAB AS RIGHTEOUS GENTILE CONVERT — Per CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX-broadened parallels: Ruth Rabbah 2:9 (treating Ruth's conversion as paradigm for righteous Gentile) + Targum Pseudo-Jonathan on Ruth 1:16 (with explicit conversion-formula expansion). Maqabis's reform of his household — removing idols, sorcerers, and diviners (3:16) + learning Torah from the Jewish captive children he had brought from Jerusalem (3:17-19) — is the most explicit Gentile-king-converts-to-Mosaic-religion narrative in the Ethiopian biblical corpus. The chapter develops Maqabis as JUDGE-PATTERN exemplar — paralleling Joshua + Gideon + Samson + Barak + Deborah + Judith (vv. 1-3 catalog) — extending the deliverer-judge typology to the converted-Gentile-king. The theological climax of 2 Meqabyan: a Gentile king becomes a righteous-king-of-Israelite-pattern.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

**JUDGE-PATTERN ROSTER** — JOSHUA + GIDEON + SAMSON + BARAK + DEBORAH + JUDITH catalog (vv. 1-3). The post-conversion 2 Mq Ch 4 develops MAQABIS-OF-MOAB AS DELIVERER-JUDGE-EXEMPLAR — but the catalog is itself DISTINCTIVELY MIXED. Joshua + Gideon + Samson + Barak + Deborah are STANDARD HEBREW-BIBLE JUDGES (Joshua book + Judges 4-16). JUDITH is a DEUTEROCANONICAL-EOTC FIGURE (Book of Judith, in the Septuagint + EOTC broader canon, deliverer of Bethulia from Holofernes by beheading — Judith 13:6-8). The INCLUSION OF JUDITH alongside the canonical-Judges is STRUCTURALLY SIGNIFICANT: it marks Meqabyan as a TEWAHEDO-BROADER-CANON-AWARE text that treats the deuterocanonical-women alongside Hebrew-Bible figures as functionally-equivalent deliverer-exemplars. The roster extends the deliverer-judge typology to the converted-Gentile-king — supporting the seed 4:15 reading of Maqabis-of-Moab as RIGHTEOUS GENTILE CONVERT integrated into the Israelite deliverer-tradition.

Éthiopiens* (Paris, 1859), no. 55, items 28-30** as another Meqabyan manuscript witness. This is the same 'Abbadie MS' already noted in v2 SOURCES.md §3 ('Cited by Dillmann; not directly examined') — Wright's citation refines the locator from manuscript-shelf-level reference to precise **catalogue-entry + item-number** (no. 55, items 28-30). The D'Abbadie *Catalogue Raisonné* is itself public domain (Paris, 1859) and likely available on archive.org and/or Gallica (the Bibliothèque nationale de France's digital library). The locator-refinement enables a future Tier-2-style audit pass to examine the D'Abbadie catalogue directly without further bibliographic search.
